# Third-party files

Hosted here so the study loads quickly in mainland China, where public CDNs and Google Fonts can be slow or blocked.

| File | Project | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `vendor/skulpt.min.js`, `vendor/skulpt-stdlib.js` | Skulpt 1.2.0 (Python in the browser, used to check answers) | MIT |
| `vendor/Sortable.min.js` | SortableJS 1.15.2 (drag to reorder in Task 1) | MIT |
| `fonts/bricolage.woff2` | Bricolage Grotesque (headings) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `fonts/nunito.woff2` | Nunito (body text) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `fonts/jbmono-400.woff2`, `fonts/jbmono-500.woff2` | JetBrains Mono (code) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

Chinese text uses the device's own fonts (PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, Noto Sans CJK SC).
